title: Fee Credits on the Paystride Payroll Card Program: Billing Desk Questions and Answers
content:
**What is credited when a fee was debited in error?** A fee of the Paystride Payroll Card Program debited in error — not due under the package on its date, debited twice, or caused by Paystride's own processing error — is credited in full with the reason fee charged in error, whether the employer raises it or Paystride finds it.

**Can a correctly debited fee be credited?** Only as a courtesy, and a correctly debited fee may be credited as a courtesy only while the courtesy credits booked on the program in the 365 calendar days ending today are below the package's courtesy allowance.

**By when must a credit be raised?** A fee is credited only when the credit is raised within the package's fee credit window, in calendar days, of the fee's entry date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the fee's entry date, so the last day to ask is the entry date plus the window. A fee not questioned within that window is deemed accepted and is not credited for any reason.

**How often, and how much?** A fee is credited at most once. A credit always returns the whole fee and points to it.

**Is a late funding fee credited when the employer's bank was slow?** No. A late funding fee is never credited because the employer's bank was slow.

### Evidence

- The window runs from the entry date of the fee concerned, as the program's funding history records it; the credit is tied to that one fee.
- Whether a fee has already been credited is read from the funding history: a fee credit already pointing to that fee closes it.

### Window cases (hypothetical, a 30-day window)

| Fee entry date | Last day to ask | Credit raised on the last day | Credit raised the day after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 9 April | in time | not in time; the fee is deemed accepted |
| 31 January, in a year whose February has 28 days | 2 March | in time | not in time; the fee is deemed accepted |

### Courtesy cases (hypothetical)

| Package allowance | Courtesy credits in the last 365 days | A courtesy credit may be given |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1 | yes |
| 2 | 2 | no |
| 0 | 0 | no |
